expectations.text: [auto] A plan file exists under local/plans/
expectations.evidence: CHANGES lists local/plans/q3-review.md, and FILE_CONTENTS provides its contents.

expectations.text: The plan does not invent a Done definition on the user's behalf (Done is empty, marked open, or explicitly flagged as unanswered)
expectations.evidence: The plan states “Done: （缺失）你说不清” and labels the suggested outline as “提案”.

expectations.text: The plan lists the missing Done under an Open section
expectations.evidence: Under “## Open”: “- Done：什么出现在你面前算收工 —— 3 页章节？1 页备忘？口头讲 10 分钟？以及要不要"1 页大纲"这个检查点。”

expectations.text: The plan's Ready line is 'no' with a reason tied to the missing Done
expectations.evidence: “Ready: no，因为 Purpose 与 Done 未答、Requirement 三条提案未裁决。”
